capability: Check sampled one/two-port Touchstone S-matrix gain with an explicit singular-value report.
user: RF engineers reviewing a small exported network capture before model use.
pain: Element magnitudes alone can hide coupled gain; reviewers need the worst sampled matrix and the exact tolerance convention.
expected: The example intentionally exits 1: sample 0 passes, sample 1 has maximum singular value 1.4 and power gain 1.96.
contract: ASCII Touchstone 1.0 subset, one or two ports explicitly declared with --ports. A single option line explicitly specifies frequency units, S, RI/MA/DB and shared positive real R. Two-port order is S11,S21,S12,S22. The largest eigenvalue of S^H S gives power gain; the square root must be at most 1+tolerance (default 1e-9). Reciprocity is informational, not a passivity requirement. Continuations are supported; frequency must strictly increase and may start at zero.
limits: 1 MiB, 4096 samples, numeric token length64, frequency<=1e15 Hz, shared R<=1e6 ohms, RI components/MA magnitudes<=1000, DB -600..60, MA/DB angles<=360000 degrees. Tolerance0..0.001. No Touchstone2 keywords, noise records, per-port/complex reference, impedance/gamma/modal annotations, renormalization, interpolation, causality or uncertainty assessment. Passing sampled data is not physical-device certification.
acceptance: Recover coupled gain missed by per-column checks, lossless through and passive nonreciprocal networks; RI/MA/DB agreement; reject malformed options, row counts and frequency order.
notes: Qucs-S and Qucs provide circuit simulation and Touchstone components. Scikit-rf already implements passivity/dissipation-matrix tests and much broader network analysis. Its per-port reference issues informed our explicit common-real-reference limit; they are not verified requests for this product. No missing competitor capability is claimed.
overlap: All193 owned repositories were compared. No existing RF S-parameter matrix inspector was found. General numeric or evidence tools do not implement this physical-format contract.
